verdict.rationale: The firm's formation page claims help with "tax-efficient choices around how to structure business entities and ownership" and the executive compensation page discusses designing equity instruments with "vesting schedules," showing the firm addresses founder equity mechanics broadly, but no evidence specifically covers 83(b) elections or explicit co-founder equity-split guidance. Missing for 10: explicit mention of 83(b) elections, concrete founder vesting schedule templates/guides, and documented equity-split mechanics among co-founders.
